verified_good_products.title: Light Gauge Steel Framing Systems
verified_good_products.description:
Traditional building techniques are now failing to meet the major challenges being faced by construction industry, resulting in a growing need for more innovative & modern methods of construction. To address the industry needs, we brings to you a Light Gauge Steel Framing solution that is safer, cleaner, more efficient, and environmentally sustainable with minimum disruption. This light-gauge galvanised steel system is effective in constructing modern, contemporary designs over multiple stories. The LGSF structures are made of galvanized light gauge metal frames, in the form of structural components. These structures are so designed to function as independent load-bearing frames capable of balancing vertical as well as lateral loads down to the building foundation. Cold roll steel so formed does not shrink, swell, split, or wrap and is non-combustible. Consistent quality in steel framing results in safer structures, less maintenance. If all these weren’t enough to convince you, it helps you manage your budget without any compromise with saving in construction cost up to 40% and up to 70% in construction time.

The framing components are designed with the help of the CAD-CAM software, visualised in a 3D Modelling software and finally checked with a Structural Stability software. Then this information is used to generate structural details to produce sections on automated CNC controlled roll-forming machine with an accuracy of +/- 0.5 mm. 

We offer a full design and supply service, including architectural, mechanical, electrical and structural solutions, and therefore can provide a turnkey package for all needs of our esteemed customers.

Features:

  • Customizable, Aesthetic, Durable, Green and Energy-efficient Building.
  • A steel-framed house can be completed in about one-thirds the time of a conventional brick and mortar home with only half the construction cost.
  • Designed with the help of the CAD-CAM software, visualised in a 3D Modelling software and finally checked with a Structural Stability software to generate structural details to produce sections on automated CNC controlled roll-forming machine with accuracy of +/- 0.5 mm.
  • Once completed, steel frame homes can look just like traditionally-built homes.
  • Modifying an existing steel frame building is relatively simple, making the design high modular.
  • Ideal for expansion of existing structures, additional floors, etc.; proving flexibility for future expansion and relocation.
  • Designed for a structural life of 95 years & above and can be used for permanent or interim requirements. 
  • When steel buildings can be dismantled and re-erected elsewhere quickly if required.
  • When a steel frame building is demolished, the steel can be completely recycled creating an Eco-friendly and Green building solution. Go Green, because the Earth needs you to.
  • Steel is non-combustible and won’t contribute to the spread of a fire.
  • A steel frame building is more resistant to the effects of severe earthquakes, hurricanes and tornados.

verified_good_products.title: Lgsf Prefabricated Steel Buildings
verified_good_products.description:
LGSF stands for Light Gauge Steel Framing, and an LGSF building service involves the design, fabrication, and construction of buildings using light gauge steel framing components. Light gauge steel framing is a construction method that uses thin sheets of steel formed into shapes to create structural elements for buildings. This method is often used for residential, commercial, and industrial structures. Here's an overview of the services typically offered by companies specializing in LGSF building construction:

  1. Design and Engineering:

    • Collaborative design process to understand the client's requirements and preferences.
    • Customization of the design to meet local building codes, load requirements, and other specifications.
    • Structural engineering analysis to ensure the design's safety and compliance with regulations.

  2. Material Selection:

    • Assistance in selecting appropriate light gauge steel materials for the framing components.

  3. Fabrication of Components:

    • Manufacturing and fabrication of light gauge steel framing components, including studs, tracks, joists, and other elements.
    • Use of precision manufacturing techniques to ensure consistency and quality.

  4. Quality Control:

    • Implementation of rigorous quality control measures during the fabrication process.
    • Inspection and testing of fabricated components to ensure they meet industry standards.

  5. Logistics and Transportation:

    • Coordination of logistics for transporting fabricated components from the manufacturing facility to the construction site.

  6. On-Site Construction:

    • On-site assembly and installation of light gauge steel framing components.
    • Collaboration with construction crews to ensure proper installation and alignment of structural elements.

  7. Customization Options:

    • Offering customization options for architectural features, finishes, and other design elements.

  8. Project Management:

    • Overall project management to ensure the construction process is well-coordinated, and timelines are met.
    • Coordination with other construction professionals, such as architects and contractors.

  9. Documentation:

    • Providing documentation related to the fabrication process, including material certificates, quality assurance reports, and assembly instructions.

  10. Maintenance and Repairs:

    • Offering maintenance services to ensure the durability and longevity of the light gauge steel framing.

When selecting an LGSF building service provider, consider their experience, reputation, and the successful completion of similar projects. Ensure they adhere to quality standards, are familiar with local building codes and regulations, and can deliver within specified timelines. Effective communication and collaboration between the service provider and other stakeholders in the construction process are crucial for a successful LGSF building project.
